Method/Read preprocessing

Quality and adapter trimming

Trim adapter sequence and low-quality bases from reads.

When to use this method

Use when

  • Reads may contain adapter sequence, which is true of almost all Illumina libraries.
  • Base quality drops toward read ends or varies between runs.
  • The library is shotgun (whole-genome or metagenomic) or amplicon-based. Apply it in both cases.

Combine with

  • Amplicon primer trimming: Required in addition for amplicon libraries, because quality trimming does not remove primer sequence.

Operation

Read preprocessing

Implementations

  • fastp
  • Trimmomatic

Needs

Raw reads

Produces

Clean reads

Reads are scanned for adapter sequence, trimmed with a sliding quality window, and discarded if they fall below a minimum length. When combined with primer trimming, apply quality and adapter trimming first.

Used by protocols

Specified by

  • Bacterial phylogenomic surveillanceStep 1
  • Fungal phylogenomic surveillanceStep 1
  • Viral phylogenomic surveillanceStep 1
